reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes)

description.lithology: The core is a light to medium grey, white-mottled intermediate to felsic crystalline rock, medium-grained with a granitoid appearance and a locally foliated / gneissic fabric. White to pale grey patches are interpreted as quartz / feldspar-rich domains intermingled with darker grey mafic / biotite-rich domains, giving a mottled, weakly banded appearance. The fabric is subparallel to the core axis with a faintly foliated / migmatitic texture visible over the length of the run.

anomalies.explanation: A single sub-vertical fracture / break is visible on the upper tray row near the right-hand end of the core, with the red orientation line offset across the break.

The run is shown in two tray rows; the upper row contains the majority of the core length and a short segment is shown in the lower left inset row, consistent with the run filling several rows in reading order.
